product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Tools & Gadgets Lazy Slotted Turner, Orange
features: Rachael Ray Tools & Gadgets, Slotted Turner, 13-Inch, Orange
Notches in the handle allow the lazy slotted turner to rest on the edge of cookware so drips fall in the pan, not on the countertop
This stylish, practical silicone turner complements the fun and functionality of the entire Rachael Ray collection
Dishwasher safe; Heat safe to 500 degrees Fahrenheit
description: Always have the right, bright kitchen tool within easy reach using the Rachael ray tools lazy slotted turner, a stylish, practical turner that boasts innovative design and a splash of bold color. A clever notch on the turner allows it to rest directly on the sides of pots, containing drips inside pans, not on countertops or stovetops and the slotted blade allows unwanted oils and fats to drip away from veggies, burgers and other delish foods. The contoured handle provides extra comfort while preparing foods and serving guests throughout the day. Rest the turner on the side of a skillet when preparing red potatoes and green peppers for Sunday brunches. An ideal partner for all cookware interiors, including nonstick, the silicone turner is heat safe to 500 Degree F and dishwasher safe for convenience. This colorful slotted turner is a great complement to serve ware, cookware and many other attractive items in the Rachael ray collection. Keep stovetops and countertops clean while cooking with help from the cleverly designed Rachael ray tools lazy slotted turner.
